content.short: Komainu is a regulated institutional custodian, with support for HYPE custody and staking.
content.description: Komainu provides regulated custody for institutional investors and issuers, holding assets in segregated accounts that are verifiable on-chain. Clients can trade, borrow or lend through its partner network while the assets themselves remain in custody. The firm positions itself as a regulated bridge into tokenized markets, adding governance and connectivity alongside the custody itself. Clients can reach Hyperliquid directly from custody.
content.meta: Komainu is a regulated institutional custodian supporting HYPE custody and staking on Hyperliquid.
